alkylation reagent: the protein was reduced with 5 mM TCEP for 60 min at 37 °C and alkylated with 10 mM chloroacetamide for 30 min at 37 °C.
alkylation concentration: the protein was reduced with 5 mM TCEP for 60 min at 37 °C and alkylated with 10 mM chloroacetamide for 30 min at 37 °C.
cleavage agent: samples were digested by incubation with sequencing-grade modified trypsin, sequencing-grade Glu-C, and sequencing-grade chymotrypsin (all 1/50, w/w; Promega, Madison, Wisconsin), respectively, overnight at 37 °C.
collision energy: The normalized collision energy was set to 28%, the mass isolation window was set to 1.4 m/z and one microscan was acquired for each spectrum.
fragmentation method: Each MS1 scan was followed by high-collision-dissociation (HCD) of the 20 most abundant precursor ions with dynamic exclusion for 20 s.
instrument: Mass spectrometry analysis was performed on Q-Exactive HF equipped with a nanoelectrospray ion source (both ThermoFisher Scientific).
ionization type: Mass spectrometry analysis was performed on Q-Exactive HF equipped with a nanoelectrospray ion source (both ThermoFisher Scientific).
labeling: Mass spectrometry analysis was performed on Q-Exactive HF equipped with a nanoelectrospray ion source (both ThermoFisher Scientific).
precursor tolerance: The precursor ion tolerance was set to 10 ppm and fragment ion tolerance was set to 0.02 Da.
fragment tolerance: The precursor ion tolerance was set to 10 ppm and fragment ion tolerance was set to 0.02 Da.
ptm: fixed carbamidomethylation (C); variable +16 on M (Oxidation); variable +42 on Peptide N-Terminal K (Acetyl); variable +126 on Y (Iodo); variable +252 on Y (Diiodo); variable +378 on Y (Triiodo); variable +14 on KR (Methyl); variable +100 on K (Succinyl); variable +80 on STY (Phospho); variable +1 on NQ (Deamidated); variable +80 on ST (Sulfo); variable +470 on Y (Triiodothyronine); variable +596 on Y (Thyroxine)

carbamidomethylation (C), was set as fixed modification. The following variable modifications were applied separately for all samples: (i) +16 on M (Oxidation), +42 on Peptide N-Terminal K (Acetyl), +126 on Y (Iodo); (ii) +16 on M (Oxidation), +252 on Y (Diiodo), +378 on Y (Triiodo); (iii) +14 on KR (Methyl), +16 on M (Oxidation), +100 on K (Succinyl); (iv) +16 on M (Oxidation), +80 on STY (Phospho); (v) +1 on NQ (Deamidated), +16 on M (Oxidation), +80 on ST (Sulfo); (vi) +16 on M (Oxidation), +470 on Y (Triiodothyronine), +596 on Y (Thyroxine).
reduction reagent: the protein was reduced with 5 mM TCEP for 60 min at 37 °C and alkylated with 10 mM chloroacetamide for 30 min at 37 °C.
reduction concentration: the protein was reduced with 5 mM TCEP for 60 min at 37 °C and alkylated with 10 mM chloroacetamide for 30 min at 37 °C.
